user.title: Stormchase
user.description: Location is taken from Home Assistant: {latitude}, {longitude}. The lightning sensors come from your existing Blitzortung integration.

location.title: Location
location.description: Choose where the weather parameters should come from. When following a device or person the integration travels with you; if no GPS position is available it falls back to your home location.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Leave the notification services empty to disable notifications. Set both quiet hours to the same time to always notify. Notifications can also be toggled later with a switch.

data.notify_on_approach: Also notify when the storm approaches
data.notify_on_cleared: Notify when the storm has passed
data.rain_notify: Also notify when rain is approaching
data.rain_lead: How many minutes ahead to warn
data.rain_threshold: Intensity from which it counts as rain
data.only_stationary: Only notify when stationary, not while travelling
data.stationary_minutes: This long slower before stationary again
data.critical_alerts: Break through silent mode for hazards

alerts.title: Weather warnings
alerts.description: Official warnings via MeteoAlarm. On automatic the integration looks up which country you are in, so you get the right warnings while travelling. Leave the region empty for the whole country.

briefing.title: Daily weather briefing
briefing.description: A summary of the weather, forecast, precipitation and any warnings. Set both times the same to keep just one.

knmi.title: KNMI (optional)
knmi.description: Official KNMI sources, used in addition within the Netherlands. Warnings, the 5-minute precipitation nowcast and the KNMI forecast work without a key. The radar map, station observations and faster updates via push notifications need free keys from the KNMI Data Platform (dataplatform.knmi.nl → Developer Portal → API Catalog). Leave a field empty to turn that feature off; outside the Netherlands and during outages Stormchase uses its existing sources.

data_description.knmi_wms_sleutel: Web Map Service: KNMI radar on the radar image and the radar outlook (−1 to +2 hours).
data_description.knmi_notificatie_sleutel: Notification Service (MQTT): fetches observations and radar as soon as KNMI announces new data.
data_description.knmi_edr_sleutel: EDR API: observations from KNMI weather stations instead of Bright Sky.
data_description.knmi_radarstijl: Colours of the KNMI radar and the map below it.

error.rings_not_ascending: Rings must be ascending and distinct.
error.knmi_sleutel_ongeldig: This does not look like a valid KNMI Data Platform key (one long string without spaces).
